title: AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT 16GB Review vs RTX 5060 Ti vs... PlayStation 5 Pro?
description:
A 16GB graphics card for $350 with performance that rivals the $430 RTX 5060 Ti and beats RTX 5060? On paper - and assuming MSRPs are real - the RX 9060 XT has the performance and the value to pose just as many headaches for Nvidia as its prior RDNA 4 cards did for 70-class. While galactic gen-on-gen perf increases are a thing of the past, the 9060 XT is still impressive against the competition. Note: AMD did not provide the 8GB model for review.
